invariants.rationale: The method expects to write to properties, so it must not be null.
The method logic accesses element methods such as getName(), so element should not be null.
The method calls element.getName().equals(...), so element.getName() should not be null to avoid NullPointerException.
An empty name for element would be atypical and may be invalid for looking up 'Properties' elements.
A MapProperties instance should always have non-negative size, confirming the collection is healthy.
